questions.question: Identify the group of the periodic table to which iron belongs.
questions.solution:

__
 
• Iron is a chemical element with the symbol Fe and atomic number 26.
 
• Group 8 is a group of chemical elements in the periodic table. It consists of iron, ruthenium, osmium and hassium.
 
• They are all** transition metals.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The columns of the periodic table are called **groups**.
 
• Members of the same group in the table have the same number of electrons in the outermost shells of their atoms and form bonds of the same type. The horizontal rows are called** periods.**

questions.question: For what discovery was Jan Evangelista Purkinje known in 1839?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** __Coined the term protoplasm.__**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jan Evangelista Purkinje** in 1839, he **coined the term protoplasm **for the fluid substance of a cell.
 
• Protoplasm is the living part of a cell that is surrounded by a plasma membrane.
 
• It is a mixture of small molecules such as ions, monosaccharides, amino acid, and macromolecules such as proteins, polysaccharides, lipids, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **plasma membrane, also called the cell membrane, **is the membrane found in all cells that separates the interior of the cell from the outside environment.
 
• The **lipid bilayer** is a universal component of all cell membranes.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f62d1d0bd31bb8785a8eaa9fb5fa73375e798abbc6a3f493d74ba1ee2da7a98a.png]

questions.question: ‘All minorities, whether based on religion or language, shall have the right to establish and administer educational institutions of their choice’. Which article of the Constitution of India guarantees this right?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 30**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 30 **gives the **Right of minorities to establish and administer educational institutions**. As follows:

 
 
• **All minorities**, whether based on **religion or language**, shall have the **right to establish **and **administer educational institutions **of **their choice.**
 
• **The state shall not**, in **granting aid **to **educational institutions**, **discriminate against **any **educational institution **on the ground that it is **under the management of a minority, **whether based on **religion or language**.
 
 
 
• **Article 30 **of the **Indian constitution **consists of **provisions **that **safeguard various rights **of the **minority community **in the country keeping in mind the **principle of equality as well**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 25 **gives **Freedom of conscience and free profession, practice and propagation of religion**.
 
• **Article 28 **gives **Freedom as to attendance at religious instruction or religious worship in certain educational institutions.**
 
• **Article 36 **is the **definition part of the Directive Principles of State Policy. **It defines what is a 'State' for Directive Principles to be followed.

questions.question: Phytoplankton, small sea-dwelling organisms, belong to which trophic level of the food web?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Primary producers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Phytoplankton**, also known as **microalgae**, are similar to **terrestrial plants **in that they contain **chlorophyll **and **require sunlight **in order to **live and grow**.
 
• **Most phytoplankton **is **buoyant **and **floats **in the **upper part of the ocean**, where **sunlight penetrates the water**.
 
• **Autotrophs **or **primary producers **are **organisms **that acquire **their energy from sunlight **and **materials from nonliving sources**.
 
• **Algae**, **higher plants**, and **some bacteria **and protists are important **autotrophs in running waters**.
 
• **Heterotrophs **obtain **energy **and **materials **by **consuming living **or **dead organic matter**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Primary consumers **make up the **second trophic level**. They are also called **herbivores**. They eat **primary producers**—**plants or algae**—and **nothing else**. For example, a **grasshopper **living in the **Everglades **is **a primary consumer**.
 
• The **organisms **that **eat the primary consumers **are **meat eaters **(carnivores) and are **called secondary consumers**. The **secondary consumers **tend to be **larger and fewer in number**. This **continues **on, all the way up to the **top of the food chain**.
 
• **Decomposers **feed on **dead things**: **dead plant **materials such as **leaf litter **and **wood, animal carcasses, and faeces**. They perform a **valuable service as Earth's cleanup crew**. Without **decomposers**, **dead leaves**, **dead insects**, and **dead animals **would **pile up everywhere.**

questions.question: Which of the following serves as the cell's digestive system, serving both to degrade material taken from outside the cell and to digest the undigested components of the cell?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lysosomes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lysosomes **are **membrane-enclosed **organelles that contain an **array of enzymes **capable of **breaking down **all types of **biological polymers**—**proteins, nucleic acids, carbohydrates, and lipids**.
 
• **A lysosome **is a **membrane-bound cell **organelle that contains **digestive enzymes**.
 
• **Lysosomes **are involved with **various cell processes**. They **break down **excess or **worn-out cell parts**.
 
• They **may be used to destroy **invading **viruses **and **bacteria**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A ribosome **is an **intercellular structure **made of both **RNA and protein**, and it is the **site of protein **synthesis in the **cell**.
 
• **SER **is involved in the **synthesis of lipids**, including **cholesterol **and **phospholipids**, which are used in the **production **of **new cellular membranes**. In cells of **the liver**, SER contributes to the **detoxification of drugs **and **harmful chemicals**.
 
• The **cytosol **is the **liquid medium contained within a cell**. The **cytosol **is a **component of the cytoplasm**. The **cytoplasm includes **the **cytosol**, all the **organelles**, and the **liquid contents inside the organelles**.

questions.question: What is India’s rank in the 2021 Global Hunger Index?

• **A country's GHI score **is **calculated **by **averaging the percentage **of the **population **that is **undernourished**, the **percentage of children younger than five years **of age who are **underweight**, and **the percentage of children **who **die before the age of five**.

questions.question: Which of the following is true?

options.text: Gross Domestic Product + Depreciation = Gross National Product
Gross Domestic Product + Depreciation = Net Domestic Product
Gross Domestic Product – Depreciation = Gross National Product
Gross Domestic Product – Depreciation = Net Domestic Product

questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**Gross Domestic Product – Depreciation = Net Domestic Product**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The net domestic product (NDP) equals the gross domestic product (GDP) minus depreciation on a country's capital goods**.
 
• Net domestic product accounts for capital that has been consumed over the year in the** form of housing, vehicle, or machinery deterioration.**
 
• Depreciation = **Depreciation of capital assets such as equipment, vehicles, housing, and more**. 
 
• As the NDP takes into **account the depreciation of capital assets, it is considered to be superior to the GDP as a measure of the well-being of a nation.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• GDP **measures the monetary value of final goods and services—that is, those that are bought by the final user—produced in a country in a given period of time.**
 
• It counts all of the output generated **within the borders of a country.**
 
• **Rising GDP means more jobs are likely to be created, and workers are more likely to get better pay rises**.
 
• **If GDP is falling**, then the economy is shrinking - **bad news for businesses and workers**.
 
• If GDP falls for two quarters in a row, that is known as a **recession, which can mean pay freezes and lost jobs.**
